史部十六類：一曰正史類，二曰編年類，三曰紀事本末類，四曰別史類，五曰雜史類，六曰詔令奏議類，七曰傳記類，八曰史鈔類，九曰載記類，十曰時令類，十一曰地理類，十二曰職官類，十三曰政書類，十四曰目錄類，十五曰金石類，十六曰史評類。
The Histories division comprises sixteen categories: (1) standard histories, (2) annals, (3) comprehensive accounts of events, (4) alternative histories, (5) miscellaneous histories, (6) edicts and memorials, (7) biographies, (8) historical excerpts, (9) regional chronicles, (10) seasonal regulations, (11) geography, (12) official posts, (13) administrative treatises, (14) bibliographies, (15) epigraphy, and (16) historical criticism.
